description: Points a domain's mail at FounderMail and authenticates what it sends, with every record pointing at FounderMail's own DNS. The receive group is the ownership challenge, the MX record, an SPF include merged into whatever SPF record the domain already has, and a DMARC policy; it is applied when the domain is claimed. The send group is two DKIM selector CNAMEs into FounderMail's DKIM zone and a CNAME for the bounce subdomain FounderMail uses as the return address; it is applied once FounderMail has issued the domain's keys, which happens after receiving is verified. A later application re-applies both groups. The hosting template (serviceId hosting) is the earlier shape of the same service, with the delivery provider's own DKIM records; both stay in use.
variableDescription: %token%: the hex ownership token FounderMail issued for this claim, published as foundermail-verify=%token%. %dmarc%: the DMARC tags after v=DMARC1, for example p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com; when the domain already publishes a DMARC record FounderMail passes its tags back unchanged. %dkimid%: the label FounderMail issued for the domain's keys in its DKIM zone, lower-case letters and digits.
